Paragraph: Then on nearing the Raghavas, Hanuma, speaking softly and pleasingly like an obedient one, hailed, greeted, and befittingly praised those two valiant ones.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman must initiate contact with unfamiliar, possibly wary strangers without provoking suspicion or hostility.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Uses gentle, respectful, courteous speech and humility to build rapport before revealing purpose.
Outcome/Resolution: A calm, non-threatening first contact is established.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman models vinaya - humility as the doorway to trust and dharmic relationship-building.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Demonstrates effective interpersonal communication: tone modulation and warmth to de-escalate potential tension in a first encounter.
